'''Galactic Solutions Industries Headquarters''' was a central office of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] (GSI), located at the [[Lucent Square]] overlook on the upper [[Promenade]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="location">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|Upper Promenade|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

The Headquaters' entrance lead to a speeder showroom and a shop of various products by GSI and its sister company [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization|THORN]], run [[Arnell Hyland]], and [[Raya Haedele]] respectively. Adjacent to the shop, Headquarters also featured a firing range for customers to test GSI products and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], as well as a requisition board for GSI contractors.<ref name="location" />
